title: Bills Due Board
summary: See every bill by due date, then mark it paid.
user: A solo operator who records bills in a personal or business finance tool and needs a clear due-date queue.
smallest_useful_product: Offline bills board with manual and CSV entry, due-date and cash-week views, attachment links, paid confirmation, and CSV export.
constraints: No bank credentials; encrypted local storage and export; planned bills stay distinct from cleared accounting transactions.
